quarterly_data.quarter: Broadcom press release: AST Completes Singapore's First High-End FC-BGA Substrate (09-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Supplier TOPPAN Holdings: a release Broadcom published on its IR site announces that Advanced Substrate Technologies (AST), a Singapore-based joint venture between TOPPAN Holdings and Broadcom, opened its FC-BGA substrate manufacturing facility in Singapore (claimed as the first in the country capable of producing high-end FC-BGA substrates, and the TOPPAN Group's first such facility outside Japan). The release states that Broadcom is TOPPAN's largest customer for FC-BGA substrates. The approximately 95,000-square-metre facility in the Jurong Lake District will manufacture large-body, high-layer-count substrates for advanced semiconductor products including AI compute and networking devices, and is targeting the start of high-value manufacturing by late-2026; AST has hired more than 200 high-tech engineers and skilled technicians since breaking ground in March 2024 and will work with TOPPAN and Broadcom to scale output as demand grows. Charlie Kawwas, president, Semiconductor Solutions Group, Broadcom: the facility, 'brought online three months early, strengthens our supply chain resilience by delivering vital relief while the industry is constrained by substrate shortages', and will deliver the next generation of large-body, high-layer-count substrates that Broadcom requires to further scale global AI infrastructure.
quarterly_data.figure: approximately 95,000-square-metre facility; high-value manufacturing targeted by late-2026; brought online three months early; more than 200 engineers and technicians hired
